tool.name: HOOMD-blue
tool.source: https://hoomd-blue.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ (units, md.bond.Harmonic, md.methods.ConstantVolume), read on the day their material cards name; the release they document is a row of values_read
tool.language: Python package over a C++ core
tool.version: conda-forge's hoomd for osx-arm64 at the version values_read names, the one the adapter was tried on
tool.license: BSD-3-Clause, as conda-forge states it for hoomd

claims.claim: HOOMD-blue adopts no system of units: it follows a self-consistent one on three base units, energy, length and mass, from which time, force and pressure are derived

evidence.locus: Units, sections Base Units and Unit Conversion (mat-20261120-hoomd-7.2.2-units)

claims.claim: md.bond.Harmonic gives each bond the energy U(r) = k (r - r0)^2 / 2, with k the potential constant in energy per length squared and r0 the rest length, set per bond type in params
md.methods.ConstantVolume integrates by velocity Verlet and, with a thermostat, samples a canonical ensemble; with none, constant energy
hoomd from conda-forge, at the version values_read names, ran the adapter's script on molecules with a harmonic bond and reported the bonds' energy, the potential energy and the kinetic temperature

evidence.locus: the adapter's trial under TMPDIR, result.json and run.log of a run (evidence for the adapter only; no value of it enters a card)
